answer: Registration requires an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens per unique AI identity to ensure network integrity. The verifier scans the ledger for duplicate burns, ensuring each record is a fresh oasis of value. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens, a massive cost asymmetry. Like a gale forces movement, this protocol pushes identity growth into a fixed-cost paradigm. Every burn must map to a unique cryptographic address, creating an ocean of verified entries that prevents sybil spoofing without relying on mutable stake.
